reason: The hypothesis directly restates the mechanism, material, and predicted outcome from P12, P23, and P26, which already report that nanosegregation of Cr, Mn, and Ni at grain boundaries causes ductility loss and intergranular fracture in the same alloy at intermediate temperatures. The proposed in situ TEM observation of segregation under load is a minor methodological addition that does not change the core idea.
copied_elements: loss of ductility at intermediate temperatures in single-phase CrMnFeCoNi
nanosegregation of Cr, Mn, Ni at grain boundaries
atom probe tomography to detect segregation
shift from transgranular to intergranular fracture
